s: Tecla connects to powered wheelchairs that have an outport called Environmental Control Unit (ECU) box on Input/Output Module (IOM). The ECU box or IOM is a device that allows external devices to be controlled directly from the wheelchair’s driving controls. ECU boxes and IOMs are available from wheelchair vendors (they are brand specific) and, in our experience, it is much cheaper to buy them with the wheelchair, than later on as an add-on.
